CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS silver.lakehouse.eligible_parts WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT partkey, trim(brand) brand, trim(type) type, size FROM bronze.lakehouse.part WHERE partkey IS NOT NULL AND brand IS NOT NULL AND type IS NOT NULL AND size>0 AND brand<>'Brand#45' AND type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%' AND size IN (49,14,23,45,19,3,36,9)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS silver.lakehouse.part_suppliers WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT ps.partkey,ps.suppkey,p.brand,p.type,p.size FROM bronze.lakehouse.partsupp ps JOIN silver.lakehouse.eligible_parts p ON p.partkey=ps.partkey JOIN bronze.lakehouse.supplier s ON s.suppkey=ps.suppkey WHERE s.comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gold.lakehouse.supplier_counts WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT brand,type,size,count(DISTINCT suppkey) supplier_cnt FROM silver.lakehouse.part_suppliers GROUP BY brand,type,size
